name: Lift licence, inspection and AMC compliance tracker for housing societies and small building owners (state lift acts)
buyer: Owners of lifts: apartment owners' associations and RWAs, small commercial building owners, hospitals/hotels/schools with lifts, plus lift maintenance (AMC) firms who handle licences for many owners; states AP, Telangana, TN, HP, Bihar, UP, Karnataka, Maharashtra
trigger: State lift acts require owner licence plus periodic inspection and renewal: AP Lifts and Escalators Bill 2025 (existing lift owners must apply for licence within 12 months of commencement; two-way communication and lighting required), Telangana draft (annual inspection, only recognised maintenance agencies; HC-prompted), TN Lifts Act licence valid one year, renewed yearly after inspection, TN Amendment Act 2025, HP Lifts (Amendment) Bill 2026 (annual renewal, fee +10 percent every 3 years), Karnataka Form G three months before expiry, UP Lifts and Escalators Act 2024, Bihar 2024. Renewal intervals conflict across sources.
evidence: https://elevatorworld.com/?p=104574 (AP bill, 403 on fetch, via search snippet) ; https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/telangana/telangana-govt-to-table-lifts-and-escalators-bill-in-cabinet-1972992 ; https://www.siasat.com/telangana-cm-clears-draft-law-on-lift-safety-after-hc-push-3511228/ ; https://teamleaseregtech.com/updates/article/52526/tamil-nadu-govt-notified-the-tamil-nadu-lifts-and-escalators-amendment-act-2025/ ; https://teamleaseregtech.com/updates/article/54483/himachal-pradesh-lifts-amendment-bill-2026/ ; https://therealtytoday.com/news/bihar-implements-comprehensive-safety-regulations-for-lifts-and-escalators ; https://www.nobrokerhood.com/blog/karnataka-lifts-escalators-and-passenger-conveyors-act/ ; Maharashtra amendment fetched https://teamleaseregtech.com/updates/article/53435/maharashtra-lifts-escalators-and-moving-walks-amendment-bill-2026 (only definitions and Superintending Engineer powers, no owner duties).
existing: Competitor search (English: lift AMC inspection licence renewal tracking software housing society): only consultancy licence-assistance pages (IncorpX, from Rs 14,999) and generic society ERP ADDA with an AMC-renewal module (tracks AMC contract dates, not the statutory licence/inspection certificate); MyGate and NoBrokerHood have lift-safety blog content only. No dedicated lift-licence tracker found. Hindi/regional-language search not run.
unchecked: Whether AP and Telangana bills are enacted/notified and commencement dates; exact renewal cycle per state; whether state electrical inspectorates already have online portals with reminders; boilers/pressure vessels not checked; Hindi/Telugu/Tamil competitor search; whether the paying buyer is the society or the lift AMC company.

first_check.duty: Owner licence or registration plus periodic inspection under state lift acts. UP (Lifts and Escalators Act 2024, rules notified July 2024): register before installation, existing lifts within six months, registration renewable every five years at Rs 5,000 per lift, and the maintenance certificate uploaded every year. Penalty amounts were not found. TN: Lifts and Escalators (Amendment) Act 2025 in force from 3 Feb 2026 (G.O.Ms.No.13), and the India.gov.in renewal service page says owners apply on Form G three months before expiry. Maharashtra: Act 2017 plus Bombay Lift Rules 1958, with an annual inspection of lifts section on the Chief Electrical Inspector's site. Renewal period is conflicting, 3 or 5 years in non-official sources. Karnataka: Act 2012, Rules 2015, with periodic inspections. Haryana and Delhi run online renewal services (Delhi Lift Rules 1942). AP: bill passed March 2025, no commencement notice found as of a July 2026 report. Telangana: still a draft awaiting Cabinet and legislature.
first_check.market: UP: about 16,000 lifts across about 12,600 registrations since Oct 2024, more than 80% in Noida. No national or per-state count of installed lifts was found for Karnataka or Maharashtra. The buyers are the many housing societies and building owners with lifts, plus the AMC firms that handle licences on their behalf.
first_check.competitor: Several states have filing portals: UP's e-portal (Oct 2024), Haryana CEI's lift new/renewal service (since Feb 2025), Delhi e-district, Assam EODB, Karnataka online applications, and Maharashtra CEI online services. These handle filing, not tracking deadlines across many lifts. ElevatorPlus (Pune) is software for lift companies that sends AMC renewal alerts 60 days before expiry. I couldn't verify whether it tracks statutory licences because GoodFirms returned 403. ADDA society ERP tracks AMC renewal dates only. IncorpX sells licence-assistance consultancy. Not checked: Telugu and Tamil competitor searches, and boilers.
first_check.reason: The duty is real and in force in several states. In UP, existing lifts had to be registered within six months, registration is renewed every five years and the yearly maintenance certificate is uploaded on an e-portal. Tamil Nadu's amendment took effect on 3 Feb 2026, and Karnataka, Maharashtra, Haryana and Delhi also have licensing. Andhra Pradesh's bill passed in March 2025 but I found no commencement notice, and Telangana's is still a draft. Nothing dedicated tracks licence deadlines across many lifts. State portals handle filing but don't send multi-lift reminders. ElevatorPlus serves AMC firms with AMC-contract alerts, but I couldn't confirm it tracks statutory licences. Renewal is yearly to five-yearly and penalties are vague. AMC firms already do this for owners, and a reminder tool is a thin feature. Housing societies are unlikely to pay much for it.

challenge_check.killer: No outright killer. Partial overlap: ADDA Compliance and AMC Tracker and NoBrokerHood statutory renewal alerts (generic, not lift-specific). ElevatorPlus (AMC alerts for lift firms). IncorpX consultancy with renewal reminders. State portals (HP e-district, TN Form G online, Assam EODB, UP portal) handle filing. Telangana Act not enacted (July 2026 report) and AP commencement unconfirmed.
challenge_check.reason: I found no single product or rule that kills this, so it survives, but only weakly. The general tools that come closest are ADDA's Compliance and AMC Tracker and NoBrokerHood's renewal-deadline alerts. Both let society committees set statutory expiry reminders, and neither page I found mentions lift licences. ElevatorPlus tracks AMC renewals for lift companies. IncorpX sells renewal reminders as part of its consultancy. Several states have online portals: HP e-district, the TN Form G online filing, Assam EODB and UP. Some of the trigger is weaker than claimed. The Telangana bill was still unenacted as of July 2026, and I found no notified commencement for AP. Renewal intervals vary by state (yearly in TN, possibly up to 5 years elsewhere). Tracking a few dates a year is a thin job, and AMC firms often absorb it.
